about.title: About Us
about.heroSubtitle: Jakarta's trusted partner for precision welding consumables since 2002.
about.storyP1: PT. Alfa Metalindo Indonesia was established in October 2002 with a clear mission: to bring world-class welding consumables and exotic materials to Indonesia's industrial sector.
about.storyP2: Over more than two decades, we have built deep relationships with global manufacturers and earned the trust of engineers and procurement teams across oil & gas, petrochemical, LNG, power, fertilizer, cement, steel, and sugar industries.
about.storyP3: Our office in Ancol, North Jakarta serves as the hub for our inventory, technical team, and customer support operations.
about.visionText: "A Better Welding Partner" — to be the most trusted and technically capable welding consumable supplier in Indonesia, valued for quality products, expert support, and reliable delivery.
about.value1Desc: We only stock products from manufacturers with proven track records in the most demanding industrial applications.
about.value2Desc: Our team understands the metallurgy behind every product we sell — not just the catalog numbers.
about.value3Desc: We build long-term relationships with our customers, not just transactions.
about.value4Desc: Extensive inventory management ensures products are available when your project schedule demands it.
about.teamSubtitle: Experienced professionals dedicated to finding you the right welding solution.
